convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (ColorXMACDCandle) with 8 buffers and non-standard smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). Depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading execution and smoothing algorithms. Multi-buffer custom indicator color-coding logic requires careful manual porting.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup

long.left: ColorXMACDCandle buffer 4 (Histogram mode) Clr[1]==2 AND Clr[0]<2
ColorXMACDCandle buffer 7 (SignalLine mode) Clr[1]==1 AND Clr[0]!=1

short.left: ColorXMACDCandle buffer 4 (Histogram mode) Clr[1]==0 AND Clr[0]>0
ColorXMACDCandle buffer 7 (SignalLine mode) Clr[1]==2 AND Clr[0]!=2

other_exits: Buy closed when histogram mode Clr[1]==0 (bearish color) or SignalLine mode Clr[1]==2; Sell closed when histogram mode Clr[1]==2 (bullish color) or SignalLine mode Clr[1]==1

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss, LOT=fixed lot size. Default LOT=4 means fixed lot of MM=0.1

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads color index buffers (0,1,2 values) from the ColorXMACDCandle custom indicator. In Histogram mode (buffer 4): Clr[1]==2 means bullish histogram candle, Clr[1]==0 means bearish. Transitions are detected by comparing current bar color (Clr[1]) to previous bar color (Clr[0]) — entry triggers on color change (Clr[0]!=Clr[1]). In SignalLine mode (buffer 7): Clr[1]==1 is bullish signal line state, Clr[1]==2 is bearish. The SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar index is sampled. Signal timestamps use SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec to mark the expected bar open time. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean input gates allowing selective enable/disable of each trade direction and closing side.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorXMACDCandle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses 9 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh — JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA are non-standard and require porting their algorithms. The indicator has 8 buffers; buffers 4 and 7 contain color indices (integer values 0/1/2) used for signal detection. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose wrappers that handle lot calculation based on MarginMode — these must be replaced with direct mt5 order calls. The SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points and may need 10x adjustment for 5-digit brokers — verify whether TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles _Point multiplication internally. Signal detection logic compares color indices across consecutive bars — straightforward to port once the indicator is available. The new-bar guard (CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh) must be replicated.
